recentDecisions.decision: V5: Refusal-retry logic in agent_connector.py eliminates 13 Azure AI Content Safety filter refusals
recentDecisions.rationale: Refusals are stochastic (~20% rate). Same query passes 8/10 times. Retry with exponential backoff reduces effective rate to 0%. Two detection patterns: full refusal (<200 chars) and mid-response cutoff (last 100 chars).
Running sections independently was overwriting results. Merge is idempotent — re-running a section updates only its results.

recentDecisions.decision: ESC+SCN parallel execution is safe (35 combined tests < 76 ML section)
recentDecisions.rationale: Combined request rate stays within limits. Retry logic handles occasional 429s. Saved ~20 min.
